correctness.rationale: The published planar convex anisotropic Cheeger representation reduces the claim to exact Minkowski-set operations. Common orthogonal symmetries commute with erosion and addition. A boundary erosion point forces a Wulff translate to touch the domain boundary, and cyclic rotation transports that contact to every Cañete edge when full k-symmetry is common. The group intersection gives the gcd lower bound and k|k_tilde is used only as a sufficient condition.

value.rationale: The theorem directly answers a concrete future-work direction in the primary 52A10 source. It makes the anticipated divisibility relation explicit, supplies the gcd partial-symmetry law, and extends the geometrically meaningful edge-contact conclusion. The result also shows that polygonality and parallel-side hypotheses are unnecessary for those two basic conclusions, providing a clean reusable structural criterion rather than an arbitrary special case.
